items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Perrae, you too? Yeah, yeah, Perrae. [INTERVIEWEE] See, I never heard their band.

ctx.x: And there's a fine rhythm section. And my buddy had a good rhythm section. Me and Guy A. Butler rap, and a little T-boy, you know, Gilmore, you know, the bass. He had a nice, nice, sometimes Simon, you see. He had a nice rhythm section. Well, the manuals band, you see, I never did hear their band. See, they always played down the Creole, like Ranzami, you know, halls like that.
Perrae, you too? Yeah, yeah, Perrae.

See, I never heard their band. They'd tell me they had fine bands, you know. I know most of the musical bands, you know. See, Vic Gasper, Oak, you know, fellas like that, you know, Piku, Teal, you know. Always had good musicians they did, you know. See, good reading musicians, you know. You get it? But all the band like Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan, they were a little tongue band. Celestane had a nice musical band. It was Ridley's band, you know. They had a nice musical band.
